testcase.name: flac and wav map to the types the media store actually accepts
alac is filed as the mp4 it actually is
characters a volume or a shell would object to are replaced
persisted creation time survives later file modifications
the name is artist then title, and carries the extension asked for
an unknown or absent codec is nothing to file
existing downloads use file time when no creation time was recorded
a row with nothing to name it falls back to the video id
youtube downloads retain their codec and resolved bitrate
high is uncapped rather than capped very high
codecs are matched however a source spells them
only lossless asks a source for the file it holds
a capped streaming ceiling no longer decides what a download keeps
old download metadata remains readable without an added date
wifi-only refuses metered connections and nothing else
